blurb: Up-Down St. Louis features more than 60 arcade games from the ‘80s and ‘90s, pinball machines, four classic skee-ball alleys, Nintendo 64 console gaming, life-size Jenga and Connect Four. All games cost 25 cents to play. The bar offers an extensive craft beer selection, bottles and cans, and house-made pizza by the slice with unique toppings.
extraNote: Monthly family hours on Sundays from 10am to 2pm
